processDefinition.processName: 客户交付验收 · 风险分级与时限
processDefinition.bpmnContent:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:smart="http://smartengine.org/schema/process" targetNamespace="http://auraboot.com/bpm">
<process id="tpm_delivery_acceptance" name="客户交付验收 · 风险分级与时限" isExecutable="true">
<startEvent id="start" name="提交交付材料"/>
<exclusiveGateway id="risk_route" name="风险与金额分级"><extensionElements><smart:properties><smart:property name="aura.ruleBinding" value="{"consumerType": "BPM", "consumerCode": "tpm_delivery_acceptance", "consumerNodeId": "risk_route", "bindingKind": "DECISION_REF", "enabled": true, "decisionBinding": {"decisionCode": "tpm_acceptance_route", "versionPolicy": "LATEST_PUBLISHED", "inputMappings": [{"input": "tpm_ac_amount", "source": {"kind": "FIELD", "scope": "record", "path": "data.tpm_ac_amount"}}, {"input": "tpm_ac_risk", "source": {"kind": "FIELD", "scope": "record", "path": "data.tpm_ac_risk"}}], "outputMappings": [{"output": "route", "target": {"kind": "PROCESS_VARIABLE", "path": "route"}}], "fallbackPolicy": {"mode": "FAIL_CLOSED"}, "traceMode": "ALWAYS", "enabled": true}}"/></smart:properties></extensionElements></exclusiveGateway>
<userTask id="tpm_standard_review" name="交付负责人 · 常规验收" smart:assigneeType="expression" smart:assignee="#tpm_ac_reviewer"/>
<userTask id="tpm_enhanced_review" name="验收负责人 · 加强审核" smart:assigneeType="expression" smart:assignee="#tpm_ac_reviewer"/>
<exclusiveGateway id="review_result" name="验收结果"/>
<serviceTask id="accepted" name="回写验收通过" smart:class="commandServiceTaskDelegate" smart:commandCode="tpm:accept_acceptance" smart:operationType="update" smart:targetRecordPid="${processBusinessKey}"/>
<serviceTask id="returned" name="退回补正材料" smart:class="commandServiceTaskDelegate" smart:commandCode="tpm:return_acceptance" smart:operationType="update" smart:targetRecordPid="${processBusinessKey}"/>
<endEvent id="end" name="保存结果与关闭时限"/>
<sequenceFlow id="f0" sourceRef="start" targetRef="risk_route"></sequenceFlow>
<sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="risk_route" targetRef="tpm_standard_review"><conditionExpression xsi:type="tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[${route == 'standard'}]]></conditionExpression></sequenceFlow>
<sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="risk_route" targetRef="tpm_enhanced_review"><conditionExpression xsi:type="tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[${route == 'enhanced'}]]></conditionExpression></sequenceFlow>
<sequenceFlow id="f3" sourceRef="tpm_standard_review" targetRef="review_result"></sequenceFlow>
<sequenceFlow id="f4" sourceRef="tpm_enhanced_review" targetRef="review_result"></sequenceFlow>
<sequenceFlow id="f5" sourceRef="review_result" targetRef="accepted"><conditionExpression xsi:type="tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[${_action == 'approve'}]]></conditionExpression></sequenceFlow>
<sequenceFlow id="f6" sourceRef="review_result" targetRef="returned"><conditionExpression xsi:type="tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[${_action == 'reject'}]]></conditionExpression></sequenceFlow>
<sequenceFlow id="f7" sourceRef="accepted" targetRef="end"></sequenceFlow>
<sequenceFlow id="f8" sourceRef="returned" targetRef="end"></sequenceFlow>
</process>
</definitions>
